title: Fix DefineMorphShape2: emit tag 84 not tag 46 for shape tweens
description: Fixed: compile.ts now imports encodeDefineMorphShape2 and calls writer.writeTag(Tag.DefineMorphShape2, ...) instead of the old tag 46 path. morphshape.ts gains: (1) capStyleBits/joinStyleBits helpers, (2) writeMorphLineStyle2Array that writes MORPHLINESTYLE2 records (cap/join flags UI16 + optional miter limit FLOAT16 + RGBA colors), (3) encodeDefineMorphShape2 that uses the MORPHLINESTYLE2 array and adds the two extra StartEdgeBounds/EndEdgeBounds RECTs and UI8 flags byte required by tag 84. Old encodeDefineMorphShape (tag 46) retained for tests that call it directly. morphshape.test.ts test 6 updated to accept tag 84. All 872 swf tests pass.
